summary: Revert the mission projection source upgrade (#3554): the carried-reason reducer and the projection definition versions return to the pre-#3554 text

replay.detail: Replay and carried-step reconciliation return to the pre-#3554 reducer: a carried step's blocker reason is again not derived from the referenced source step at the carry cut, and the one-time repair of persisted terminal dates and carried rows no longer exists. A copy that already ran the repair is not reverted by deleting this hook. Persisted terminal-date and carried-reason divergence is deliberately left unresolved by this change.

schema.detail: No table, storage-version or claim-schema change; the local meta marker the reverted change would have written is no longer written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint retention rules, rules version, envelopes, seals or trim permission changes.

compatibility.detail: The three explicit projection definition versions (mission_runs, run_generations, step_runs at 2) disappear again and the previous implicit definitions apply. A member that ran #3554 and a member on this build compare those projections under different definitions; the members reported to be still on the cd947aaa build never ran #3554. This does not claim that no other deployment ever ran #3554.

downtime.detail: Removing #3554 removes its synchronous first-open walk of every terminal run, generation and carried step claim. Startup cost of the other commits since the last deployed build is not measured; a revert is not a startup qualification of main.

manual.detail: No manual step. Deploy through the normal reviewed rollout.

recovery.detail: Reverting a binary is not a projection repair: a copy that was already repaired keeps its repaired rows, and the divergence this revert leaves open is tracked separately.
